name: verve
description: Strip AI tells from prose and put a human voice back, in British or American English, pitched at the reader it is for. A catalogue of tells across content, language, style, assistant artefacts, filler, condescension and overshare, four tone presets, three strength levels, a two-way politeness check that catches both talking down and going cold, an overshare check that flags what you are giving away without ever cutting a fact on its own initiative, and three pass/fail exit gates where fidelity, audience fit and disclosure each hold a veto. Runs entirely in the conversation: no packages, no API key, no network call and no paid tier.
